intent: Choose several values. Selected values stay in the field as removable tags, and typing filters the list.
useWhen: Several values from a list, shown as tags in the field
The list is long enough that the person filters it while choosing
doNotUseWhen: One value — use Select or Combobox
A short list in a menu — use Select multiple
Tags the person types — use TagInput

maxVisible.note: Extra selections collapse into a kit Badge +N.

name.note: Hidden input joins values with commas.

requirements: Escape closes only this panel, not a parent Modal, Drawer or AlertDialog
The filter input is role=combobox. The popup is role=listbox aria-multiselectable=true
Each option is role=option with aria-selected. Enter toggles the active option. The list stays open
Backspace on an empty query removes the last tag. Each tag remove button removes that value
Escape closes and returns focus to the input
Must have a Field label or ariaLabel

doNot: Do not invent a local chip list — selected values are kit Tag
Do not invent an overflow chip — the overflow count is kit Badge
Do not use Select valueDisplay=tags when the filter must live in the field
snippet: <Field label="Teams" htmlFor="teams"><MultiSelect id="teams" placeholder="Select teams" options={teams} /></Field>
